newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down on Tokyo's losses.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down on Tokyo's losses.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower after a weaker Tokyo market and poor demand further dampened sentiment, traders said.
"Overseas market like Japan was down, so our market has to follow the trend," a dealer at a trading house said. The fall also reflected a technical correction.
"Indonesian prices were higher so we had to bring down Malaysian prices to attact buying orders," the trader said.
Dealers said some latex enquiries from Europe were seen but buyers were just checking prices.
Traders offered SMR 20 at 287 to 288 cents a kg for April, SMR CV at 353, SMR L at 333 to 335, SMR 10 at 288 and drum latex FOB at 236.
At the close, April RSS Ones fell two cents to 300 cents ($1.21) a kg and April SMR 20 buyer at 286.50 cents.
The INRO five-day average was 230.48 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on March 20 from 231.04 on March 19.
The daily indicator was 229.17 against 229.07. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.4785 ringgit)
